==Description==
'''A-200i''', also known as "Insidae Prime" (stylized "Insidæ Prime", pronounced "Inside Prime") is the 5th I variant you will meet in rooms found footage A section. It requires you to be patient after '''A-200''' disappears.

==Behavior==
Like [[A-60i]], '''A-200i''' cannot spawn on its own, instead, it only spawns after A-200 despawns, producing extra static on screen if it does spawn.  

Once active, '''A-200i''' will make a wind noise similar to [[A-200]]’s, then '''A-200i''' will backtrack through the rooms very quietly. '''A-200i''' will go back a random number of rooms and rebound and random number of times. 

Unlike than the [[A-200|normal counterpart]], '''A-200i''' does not deactivate [[Claustrophobia]], so constantly getting in and out of your locker is mandatory to survive it.  

After '''A-200i''' has finished rebounding, it creates a swirl under it and submerges into the swirl, similarly to [[D-35i]], while the static returns to normal. 

== Strategy & Tips ==
* Try using '''Safe spots''' when [[A-200]] spawn at first to avoid getting trouble with '''A-200i'''.
* If '''A-200i''' spawns, you could just move to a '''Safe spot''', or just listen for its sound to hide when its close.
* If [[A-135]] is active while '''A-200i''' spawns, you should just stay in the locker until '''A-200i''' despawn.
* '''A-200i's''' locker snipe isn't lethal, so it's okay to not sprint-hide, but make sure to heal yourself if locker sniped.
* If possible, try to look back to the previous rooms to try and see where '''A-200i''' is.

== Trivia ==
* '''A-200i''' is now (almost) guaranteed to spawn after [[A-200]] in [[Red Rooms]].
